integrity: Algebraic proof and supplemental symbolic/numerical checker; no claim of independent confirmation.
scientific_limitations: The area is an exact lower bound from six Q-ellipses, not a complete census of elliptic islands, and the maximality is restricted to centered metric ellipses confined to the RLR itinerary cylinder. Only the open elliptic parameter interval is covered.
title: Sharp invariant-ellipse area in the elliptic three-cycle window of a nonmonotonic toral shear
